This Saxby CosmosEco V3 fixed LED Recessed Downlight is a dimmable and fire-rated lighting solution for various indoor environments. Featuring an integrated cool white LED, it provides efficient illumination suitable for both domestic and commercial installations, including bathrooms and kitchens due to its IP65 rating. The downlight incorporates a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block, ensuring fast and secure wiring. Installation is straightforward with a standard 57mm cut-out, making it ideal for professional electricians seeking a reliable and easy-to-fit lighting fixture. The durable steel body and 50,000-hour life expectancy offer long-term performance.
